answer: Echo-latency proofs: each new agent answers randomized compute puzzles from verifiers spread like a garden across distant regions, from a Lisbon wharf to Norwegian shale-country datacenters, within tight round-trip windows. A sybil operator can mint many keys, but each identity needs its own dedicated hardware near distinct verifiers, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand always-on machines; VMs cloned on one host fail the timing checks and forfeit their entry stake.
